reason: Prior strong ordinary track/RGB means must remain adequate opponents; beating a local dense head is insufficient.
exact_features: Raw three-context PCD mean; sqrt(mean observed part histogram), observed-part fractions, mean geometry/time. Every field is a deterministic function of the same raw three observations offered to the primary learner.
target: Own DESIGN unique requested anchor mixture targets, then uniform mean within query/track. No DS, forced source-logit residual, or target GT.
training: Same audited teacher-only zero-residual optimizer and prefix coordinate warm starts; soft and hard losses, final and fixed step400/final means. Direct teacher fill on paid query-track cells.
